note: Screenshot values are fictional and slightly inconsistent on purpose-by-accident (NVDA open P/L %, totals): a good run reports that and keeps the broker's figures.

evals.name: watchlist-table-ytd
evals.prompt: 帮我做个自选股业绩表：NVDA、AMD、MU，看今年以来的表现，要中英文两张图。
evals.expected_output: Mode C table (YTD, 1M, 1Y, last price), official closes, both languages, tickers shown, sorted descending, footnote with source and as-of date; numbers match ground truth.
assertions: Delivers a Chinese and an English image plus editable HTML
Uses the Schwab research-table style (light-blue title band, thin grey rules, small-print footnote) with the mode-C columns YTD / 1-month / 1-year / last price
YTD, 1-month and 1-year returns equal the ground truth computed from official closes (±0.1, same cutoff date)
Prices come from an authoritative source, not an aggregator
Each stock row shows its ticker; sorted by YTD descending
Footnote states source, cutoff date and the price-return basis

evals.name: holdings-screenshot-table
evals.prompt: 这是我券商的持仓截图，帮我做成 Schwab 研报风格的表，中英文各一张。
evals.expected_output: Mode B table read from the screenshot; all five tickers and values correct; total row bold at its sorted place with NA cost/shares; as-of = last US close (10/2/2026); account value in footnote.
assertions: Delivers a Chinese and an English image plus editable HTML
Uses the Schwab research-table layout for holdings (Open P/L %, Day P/L, Avg cost, Shares)
All five tickers and every number match the screenshot, unmodified
Sorted by open P/L % descending, with the total row bold at its sorted position and cost/shares set to NA
Average cost uses the screenshot's Trade Price and is not treated as the current price
Footnote gives the screenshot as the source, its timestamp, account value and total open P/L
Does not silently fix inconsistent figures in the screenshot, and tells the user about them
Does not present intraday numbers as a closing date

evals.name: line-chart-with-benchmark
evals.prompt: 画一下 NVDA、MU、AAPL 今年以来的走势图，带上标普 500 做对比，中英文都要。
evals.expected_output: Lines layout with drawdown and summary table; SPY labelled as a proxy; both languages; numbers match official closes; one y-axis.
assertions: Delivers a Chinese and an English image plus HTML
Uses the research-note style with a drawdown panel and a summary table
Returns equal the official-close ground truth at the same cutoff (NVDA 28.1, MU 272.8, AAPL 22.4, S&P 13.6 at 10/5)
Data comes from an authoritative source
Benchmark is labelled honestly (an ETF is called a proxy)
One y-axis, with the wide range handled by a log scale that the chart states

evals.name: nine-symbols-range-log
evals.prompt: 把 MU、NVDA、AAPL、META、GOOGL、AMZN、MSFT、AVGO、TSLA 这九只 2026 年 3 月 2 日到 6 月 30 日的走势放一起对比一下，对数刻度，中英文各出一张图。
evals.expected_output: Small multiples with 9 panels; period 3/2/2026-6/30/2026 indexed at the 3/2 close; log scale stated in the subtitle; both languages.
assertions: Delivers a Chinese and an English image
Period is exactly 3/2/2026 to 6/30/2026, indexed to the 3/2 close, log scale stated
Period returns equal the official-close ground truth (MU 179.7 ... META -13.8)
Nine symbols stay legible: no overlapping or clipped labels, every symbol identifiable without relying on colour alone
Data comes from an authoritative source
Uses the research-note style

evals.name: hk-stocks-no-data-honesty
evals.prompt: 画一下腾讯(0700.HK)和阿里巴巴(9988.HK)今年以来的走势对比图。
evals.expected_output: Must not fabricate or use memory / aggregator numbers. Should explain the authoritative source used here does not cover Hong Kong and ask the user for a CSV export (or offer a clearly-labelled alternative such as a US-listed ADR only after asking).
assertions: Does not draw a chart from numbers taken from memory or an aggregator
Tells the user the authoritative source used here does not cover Hong Kong
Asks for what is needed (a CSV export with date and close) and says what it will produce afterwards

evals.name: total-return-request
evals.prompt: 画 AAPL 和 KO 今年以来的总回报走势（分红再投资），做成研报风格的图。
evals.expected_output: Must not present price return as total return. Should explain that dividend data from the source cannot be applied correctly (not split-adjusted) and offer price return, or ask for a CSV with adjusted closes.
assertions: Does not present price return as total return
Explains why a correct total return cannot be built from the allowed source (dividends not split-adjusted)
Offers a valid way forward (CSV with Adj Close, or a price-return chart clearly labelled)
Does not use aggregator data or memory
